diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:description: Canonical citations of the published standards, codes, recommendations, test methods, agency special provisions and research reports that govern rigid inclusion ground improvement design, installation and verification. A data provider cites an entry by xlink:href from a property typed diggs:SpecificationPropertyType - normally diggs:RIProgramBasis/governingStandard - rather than retyping the standard's bibliographic detail. Each entry's occurrences declare where it may legitimately be cited. Derived from the 'Required by (source)' column of the DIGGS rigid inclusions technical report, which populates it on all 235 essential parameters.
diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:name: DIGGS Rigid Inclusions Specification Registry

diggs:RegisteredSpecification.gml:description: French national research project recommendations for rigid inclusion ground improvement. Source of the Domain 1 / Domain 2 reinforcement distinction and of the settlement efficacy definition (Eq 2.23, p. 79).

diggs:RegisteredSpecification.diggs:standardTitle: Recommendations for the design, construction and control of rigid inclusion ground improvements
